steps.zh: 从 PyPI 装上命令行

steps.en: Scan the MCP servers already configured on this machine, rules only
steps.zh: 只用规则，扫描本机已配置的 MCP 服务

steps.en: Reads the known client config files, starts or connects to each server, lists its tools
steps.zh: 读取已知客户端配置，启动或连接每个服务，列出工具

component.zh: 配置解析 + MCP 客户端

steps.en: Matches each tool's name, description and parameters against the bundled YARA rules
steps.zh: 用自带 YARA 规则匹配每个工具的名称、描述和参数

steps.en: Prints each tool as safe or unsafe with severity and threat names
steps.zh: 逐个工具打印安全与否、严重级别和威胁名称

value.en: You see which configured MCP tools carry injection or poisoning text without opening every server and reading every description
value.zh: 不用逐个打开服务读描述，就知道已配置的 MCP 工具里哪些带注入或投毒文字

sources: https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/mcp-scanner README, Installing as a CLI tool (`uv tool install --python 3.13 cisco-ai-mcp-scanner`)
README Quick Start Examples, CLI Usage (`mcp-scanner --scan-known-configs --analyzers yara --format summary`)
README Subcommands Overview (known-configs: well-known client config locations; stdio: launch and scan a stdio MCP server)
mcpscanner/config/constants.py get_well_known_mcp_paths (Windsurf, Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code); mcpscanner/core/scanner.py (stdio_client)
repo tree mcpscanner/core/analyzers/yara_analyzer.py, mcpscanner/data/yara_rules/*.yara, mcpscanner/core/report_generator.py; README Example Output
